questions.question: Who does Voldemort have Nagini kill, because he thinks that man is master of the Elder Wand?
questions.note: It happens in the boathouse. Voldemort is wrong. Snape did not disarm Dumbledore.

questions.question: Who disarmed Dumbledore on the Astronomy Tower, so the Elder Wand's loyalty passed to him?
questions.note: Harry later takes Draco's wand at Malfoy Manor. That is how the Elder Wand comes to belong to Harry.

questions.question: What does Harry do with the Elder Wand at the end of the film?
questions.answer: He snaps it and throws the pieces away
choices: He snaps it and throws the pieces away
He puts it back in Dumbledore's tomb
questions.note: In the book he uses it to repair his own holly wand, then returns the Elder Wand to the tomb. The film has him break it.

questions.question: What are Snape's last words to Harry?
questions.note: He wants to see Lily's eyes. He gives Harry the memories before he dies.

questions.question: Dumbledore says, 'After all this time?' What does Snape answer?
questions.note: He has just cast his Patronus in the headmaster's office. Dumbledore is asking how long Snape has loved Lily.

questions.question: What animal is Snape's Patronus?
questions.note: Lily's was a doe too. That silver doe is what led Harry to the Sword of Gryffindor in the forest pool.

questions.question: Why does Harry survive the Killing Curse in the Forbidden Forest?
questions.answer: The curse destroys the Horcrux in him
choices: The curse destroys the Horcrux in him
The Resurrection Stone pulls him back
The Invisibility Cloak turns the curse
questions.note: Voldemort never meant to make Harry a Horcrux. The curse kills that piece of soul. Harry then chooses to return.

questions.question: What is the full name of Harry and Ginny's younger son?
questions.note: On platform 9 3/4. Harry tells him he was named for two headmasters, and that the Slytherin one was probably the bravest man he ever knew.

questions.question: How long after the battle is the station epilogue set?
questions.note: The film puts the words on screen. James teases Albus. Lily is the youngest.

questions.question: Who does Ron kiss in the Chamber of Secrets during the battle?
questions.note: It happens in the Chamber, just after she destroys Hufflepuff's cup with a basilisk fang.
